qual%20durations%2C%20those%20summaries%20need%20not%20agree.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**Try%20it.**%20Change%20one%20duration%20in%20%60recorded_durations_s%60%2C%20run%20its%20defining%20cell%2C%20and%20explain%20the%20updated%20table%20and%20mean.%20Then%20try%20making%20every%20duration%20zero%3A%20the%20summary%20should%20report%20no%20valid%20speeds%20rather%20than%20invent%20an%20average.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Checkpoint%20questions%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20How%20do%20assignment%2C%20equality%20comparison%2C%20and%20approximate%20floating-point%20comparison%20differ%3F%0A%20%20%20%202.%20What%20is%20the%20difference%20between%20a%20list%20and%20a%20NumPy%20array%20when%20multiplying%20by%20a%20scalar%3F%0A%20%20%20%203.%20Why%20can%20modifying%20an%20alias%20also%20change%20the%20original%20list%3F%0A%20%20%20%204.%20What%20do%20a%20function's%20parameters%2C%20docstring%2C%20and%20return%20value%20tell%20you%3F%0A%20%20%20%205.%20How%20do%20you%20read%20an%20error%20without%20hiding%20invalid%20data%3F%0A%20%20%20%206.%20What%20do%20rows%20and%20columns%20mean%20in%20your%20array%20or%20table%3F%0A%20%20%20%207.%20Why%20does%20a%20marimo%20cell%20update%20when%20an%20input%20changes%2C%20and%20what%20changes%20are%20not%20tracked%3F%0A%20%20%20%208.%20What%20must%20accompany%20a%20scientific%20number%20or%20figure%20so%20another%20person%20can%20interpret%20it%3F%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%20details%20%7C%20Checkpoint%20answers%0A%20%20%20%201.%20%60%3D%60%20assigns%20a%20value%2C%20%60%3D%3D%60%20compares%20values%2C%20and%20a%20tolerance-based%20function%20such%20as%20%60math.isclose%60%20checks%20approximate%20agreement.%0A%20%20%20%202.%20A%20list%20repeats%20its%20items%3B%20a%20numeric%20array%20multiplies%20each%20element.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20The%20names%20refer%20to%20the%20same%20mutable%20object%3B%20assignment%20did%20not%20copy%20it.%0A%20%20%20%204.%20Parameters%20state%20the%20inputs%2C%20the%20docstring%20explains%20their%20meaning%20and%20domain%2C%20and%20the%20return%20value%20is%20the%20result%20the%20caller%20can%20reuse.%0A%20%20%20%205.%20Inspect%20the%20exception%20type%2C%20message%2C%20and%20indicated%20source%20line%3B%20validate%20inputs%20and%20handle%20only%20expected%20failures%2C%20recording%20exclusions.%0A%20%20%20%206.%20Their%20meaning%20comes%20from%20the%20data%20model%2C%20not%20the%20container%3B%20state%20whether%20they%20represent%20participants%2C%20trials%2C%20time%20points%2C%20or%20variables.%0A%20%20%20%207.%20marimo%20tracks%20dependencies%20through%20names.%20In-place%20mutations%20in%20another%20cell%20are%20not%20tracked%3B%20create%20a%20new%20object%20or%20mutate%20in%20its%20defining%20cell.%0A%20%20%20%208.%20Units%2C%20labels%2C%20input%20provenance%2C%20assumptions%2C%20and%20enough%20information%20to%20reproduce%20the%20calculation.%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Problems%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Use%20new%20cells%20with%20distinct%20shared%20names%2C%20or%20scratch%20names%20beginning%20with%20%60_%60.%20Keep%20each%20problem's%20inputs%20explicit%20so%20another%20reader%20can%20reproduce%20the%20result.%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20Calculate%20the%20speed%20of%20a%2012%20m%20walk%20completed%20in%208%20s.%20Report%20it%20in%20m%2Fs%20and%20km%2Fh.%0A%20%20%20%202.%20For%20%60%5B2%2C%204%2C%206%2C%208%5D%60%2C%20give%20the%20slice%20selecting%20the%20middle%20two%20values%2C%20then%20calculate%20the%20mean%20using%20built-in%20functions.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20Write%20a%20Boolean%20expression%20that%20accepts%20durations%20greater%20than%20zero%20and%20at%20most%2010%20s.%0A%20%20%20%204.%20Write%20a%20function%20that%20takes%20a%20list%20of%20positive%20durations%20and%20a%20distance%20and%20returns%20a%20list%20of% ion_s%20%3C%3D%2010%60.%0A%20%20%20%204.%20%60%5B1.5%2C%201.2%2C%202.0%5D%60%20m%2Fs.%0A%20%20%20%205.%20Use%20%60.copy()%60%3B%20modifying%20the%20new%20flat%20list%20leaves%20the%20original%20unchanged.%0A%20%20%20%206.%20Shape%20%60(2%2C%203)%60%3B%20row%20means%20%60%5B2.0%2C%205.0%5D%60.%0A%20%20%20%207.%204.0%20m.%0A%20%20%20%208.%205%20and%2040%20Hz%20meet%20the%20numerical%20cutoff%20constraint%3B%20suitability%20still%20depends%20on%20the%20signal%20and%20scientific%20question.%0A%20%20%20%209.%20Derivative%20%243x%5E2%24%3B%20definite%20integral%204.%0A%20%20%20%2010.%20Approximately%203.161.%20Doubling%20%24%5Ctau%24%20doubles%20the%20time%20needed%20to%20reach%20that%20same%20response%20fraction.%0A%20%20%20%2011.%20Approximately%201.502506%20m%2Fs%20and%201.5%20m%2Fs%2C%20respectively%3B%20the%20first%20averages%20ratios%2C%20while%20the%20second%20is%20a%20time-weighted%20average%20of%20speeds.%0A%20%20%20%2012.%20Six%20rows%20and%20five%20named%20columns%3A%20%60participant%60%2C%20%60condition%60%2C%20%60distance_m%60%2C%20%60duration_s%60%2C%20and%20%60speed_m_s%60.%20Mean%20speeds%20are%20approximately%201.414%20and%201.938%20m%2Fs%20for%20the%20comfortable%20and%20fast%20conditions.%0A%20%20%20%20%2F%2F%2F%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%20Go%20deeper%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Continue%20with%20%5BScalar%20and%20vector%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fmolab.marimo.io%2Fgithub%2FBMClab%2FBMC%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fnotebooks%2Fscalar_vector.py)%20for%20array-based%20mechanics%2C%20%5BCode%20structure%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fmolab.marimo.io%2Fgithub%2FBMClab%2FBMC%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fnotebooks%2Fcode_structure.py)%20for%20repeated%20file%20processing%2C%20and%20%5BData%20filtering%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fmolab.marimo.io%2Fgithub%2FBMClab%2FBMC%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fnotebooks%2Fdata_filtering.py)%20for%20a%20closer%20look%20at%20signal%20processing.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20For%20longer%20
